summary: Varargs batch dispatcher: when the count argument a2 is positive, iterates over the stack varargs following a2, calling sub_58FCB0(a1, <arg>) once per element. Returns the result of the last sub_58FCB0 call (or an undefined value when a2 is not positive).

operations.description: Guard on a2 > 0: the dispatch loop only runs when the count argument is positive.
Countdown do-while loop iterating a2 times, using a copy of a2 as the counter.
Each iteration reads the next vararg (v3[1] with v3 advancing from the address of a2) into v5.
Call sub_58FCB0(a1, v5), passing the fixed first argument a1 and the current vararg; store the return value as result.
Return the last call result after the loop completes.

clean_pseudocode: do { int v5 = p[1]; ++p; result = sub_58FCB0(a1, v5); --n; } while (n);
unresolved: Purpose of sub_58FCB0 and the meaning of a1 are caller-supplied and unknown here.
Return value is undefined when a2 is not positive (result never assigned).
